## 12.12

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > 12.12] (1) Where proceedings are started—

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > 12.12] (a) due to limitation, the Court Pack to be prepared by the claimant must contain the documents and evidence set out in Table D;

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > 12.12] (b) to make an application for an interim payment previously requested, the Court Pack to be prepared by the claimant must contain the documents and evidence set out in Table E;

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > 12.12] (c) in respect of non-payment of an agreed interim payment, the Court Pack to be prepared by the claimant must contain the documents and evidence set out in Table G (1);

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > 12.12] (d) in respect of a dispute over fees , the Court Pack to be prepared by the claimant must contain the documents and evidence set out in Table F;

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > 12.12] (e) in respect of non-payment of an agreed settlement, the Court Pack to be prepared by the claimant must contain the documents and evidence set out in Table G (2).

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > 12.12] (2) The court form generated is Form RTASC O.

## Defendant’s Version of Events

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Defendant’s Version of Events] This document must be signed by the defendant driver:

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Defendant’s Version of Events] My version of events is:

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Defendant’s Version of Events] Version of events

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Defendant’s Version of Events] The version of events stated in this form must be the same as that provided in the compensator’s response where it has been confirmed that the compensator has the defendant’s version of events.

## Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] We send these instructions on behalf of the claimant [NAME and ADDRESS], who has consented to this request.  Please note that we are not acting as the claimant’s representative in this matter and the claimant is unrepresented and brings this claim via the RTA Small Claims Protocol.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] You should contact the claimant direct to arrange an appointment. Your report must be sent direct to the claimant for consideration. No copy should be sent to us .

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] We can confirm that we will meet your reasonable fees for preparation of the report.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] The claimant’s injuries follow a road traffic accident on [date].  [Liability/ Fault] has been [admitted], [admitted in part].

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] Reason for instruction :

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] The claimant has advised that they need a further report from a [type of expert] because:

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] [delete as appropriate]

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] it is recommended in the first expert’s report; or

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] the first medical report recommends that further time is required before a prognosis of the claimant’s injuries can be determined; or

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] the claimant is receiving continuing treatment; or

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] the claimant has not recovered as expected in the original prognosis.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] Further information [if applicable]

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] The claimant has provided further information about their request for a further report as follows: details

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] It is not expected that you will need to review any medical records. If you consider that they are required before you can express a final opinion please contact the claimant to arrange obtaining the relevant records.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] Instruction

[Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (“The RTA Small Claims Protocol”) > Standard instructions for use by compensator requesting further report on claimant’s behalf] Please would you arrange to examine the claimant and provide a report on their injuries arising from the accident. You should make clear when expressing a prognosis for recovery as to when the period of recovery starts from and ends respectively.
